title: Notice Lead Time of a Rent Increase and the Retention Share (Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement)
content:
The increase's notice lead time adds to the retention share of a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement, counted in calendar days from the increase notice date to its effective date:

| Calendar days from notice date to effective date | Addition |
|---|---|
| 35 or fewer | 3 percentage points |
| 36 to 50 | 1 point |
| more than 50 | none |

The notice date and the effective date are those on the existing-customer increase notice in the agreement's rent change history.

## Hypothetical cases

- Notice dated 1 March, effective 5 April: 35 days, 3 points.
- Notice dated 1 March, effective 6 April: 36 days, 1 point.
- Notice dated 1 March, effective 20 April: 50 days, 1 point.
- Notice dated 1 March, effective 21 April: 51 days, nothing.
